concerns.text: T019d (Runtime Integration) lists 'T012c' as a dependency, but T012c is the skeleton app entry point created in Phase 3. The schema validation hook (T019d) must logically depend on the app skeleton (T012c) being defined, yet T012c is scheduled *after* T019d. This creates a circular or forward-reference dependency violation where a foundational integration task depends on a task that hasn't been created yet in the sequence.

T019b (Create schema) and T019c (Implement validator) are marked [P] (parallel-safe) in Phase 2. However, T019c explicitly depends on T019b ('Dependencies: T019b'). Tasks marked [P] must have no dependencies on each other to be truly parallel. This is a semantic violation of the [P] tag.

T031-gen (Synthetic Data Generator) and T031-cli are marked as incomplete/active, yet T099 (Full Pipeline Integration Test) is marked complete and depends on them. The CI gate (T099) cannot execute if its prerequisite (T031-gen) is not implemented. This is a hard ordering violation: consumer (T099) before producer (T031-gen).

T023a (Implement Repeated Measures ANOVA) is marked incomplete, yet T025c-orch (Orchestrate statistical engine) and T105 (Integrate Power Results) depend on it. The orchestration task cannot function without the core statistical engine implementation. This blocks the entire analysis pipeline.

T027a, T027b, T027c (Visualization tasks) are marked incomplete/rejected, yet T028-viz (Notebook visualization cells) depends on them. The notebook cannot be finalized with visualization cells if the underlying visualization functions do not exist. This violates the producer-before-consumer rule.

T036 (Implement PowerCalculator) is marked incomplete, yet T036b (Generate power report) and T105 (Integrate Power Results) depend on it. The report generation and integration tasks cannot proceed without the calculator implementation.

T124 (Cleanup Phase 13) depends on T123 (Document Power Analysis Limitations), which is marked as rejected/incomplete. A cleanup task cannot verify the removal of tasks if its dependency (the documentation of limitations) is not yet produced.

T019d lists 'T012c' as a dependency, but T012c is in Phase 3. While T012c is the app skeleton, the dependency should likely be on the *concept* of the app or a specific initialization task, but the current ordering places the dependency on a task that appears later in the document, confusing the execution flow.
